title: Extremal numbers of acyclic matrices
summary: For a zero-one matrix $P$, let $\operatorname{Ex}(n,P)$ denote the maximum number of ones in an $n\times n$ zero-one matrix avoiding $P$. We prove that $$\operatorname{Ex}(n,P) \leq n^{1+O_P(1/\log\log n)}$$ for every acyclic $P$, settling the weak form of the Pach-Tardos conjecture.
